cells.forex: Studied approaches include trend following, range trading and trading around news, each with its own risks.
cells.stocks: Long-term investing, swing trading and value or growth approaches are widely studied.
cells.penny_stocks: Often the best-tested decision is to stay out; strategies here face high costs and manipulation risk.
cells.commodities: Trend following, spread trading and supply-and-demand analysis are commonly studied.
cells.futures: Trend following, spread trading such as [[calendar-spread|calendar spreads]], and hedging are commonly studied.

caveat: These are approaches people study, not recommendations. No strategy works in every market or period; test any idea on simulated or historical data first.
